news.headline: Sources: Colts willing to trade RB Jonathan Taylor, active in talks with teams
news.description: The Colts now are open to trading Jonathan Taylor, sources told ESPN and NFL Network, and multiple teams have reached out to Indianapolis.

news.headline: Records show 3 other women accused Packers' Josh Jacobs of abuse after arrest
news.description: Three other women contacted police to detail allegations of abuse against Packers RB Josh Jacobs following his May arrest for an altercation with his then-girlfriend.

news.headline: Ravens QB Jackson to return for Bills clash, calls ankle pain 'bearable'
news.description: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson will return to play Sunday at Buffalo, saying the pain in his injured left ankle is "bearable."

news.headline: Will the Bills' defense stop them from winning a Super Bowl?
news.description: Buffalo's defense ranks among the worst in several key statistical areas, including the third-most points allowed.

news.headline: Joe Burrow's trust makes Tee Higgins level up for Bengals
news.description: No receiver in the NFL has been better on tight window throws this season than the Bengals' Tee Higgins.

news.headline: Eagles' Saquon Barkley carries no injury designation for Commanders matchup
news.description: Saquon Barkley, who did not practice Wednesday or Thursday and was a limited participant Friday, carries no designation into Sunday's game.

news.headline: Bills making contingencies if hurt starters aren't available
news.description: The Bills have listed starters DJ Moore (shoulder), right tackle Spencer Brown (back) and nickel Dee Alford (ankle) as questionable vs. the Ravens.

news.headline: Ravens coach Jesse Minter expects Lamar Jackson back this week
news.description: Ravens coach Jesse Minter expects Lamar Jackson back this week

news.headline: Patriots WR A.J. Brown (ankle, knee) listed as questionable
news.description: Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown is questionable for Sunday's road game against the Dolphins after missing the past two practices due to knee and ankle issues.

build.name: Dynasty Juggernaut
build.about: Strong now and strong later: top-third points and top-third dynasty value without an old core.
plan: Win now without spending the future: trade depth and later picks for upgrades, not young starters.
Sell any starter about to age out a year early while he still has value.
Keep one or two firsts a year so the window never closes.
reasons: 1st of 14 in points a week the rest of the way (217.0)
32% of player value is 24 or younger (8th most)

build.name: All-In Veterans
build.about: Built to win this year on older starters; the window is one or two seasons.
plan: Push every chip in: future picks are worth more to you as points now.
Buy proven vets that rebuilders are dumping at a discount.
Plan the exit: sell the oldest starters the offseason after the title run, before their value drops.
reasons: 4th of 14 in points a week the rest of the way (192.5)
